notes: PMICE includes modernization of SOTEL: 200 GSM/3G/4G sites, core network, subscriber capacity expansion 300,000 to 1,000,000 (2020 plan); Phase I extension of SOTEL wireless network included in the 20 Dec 2025 provisional reception (Ecofin).
